name: Vanta
summary: Compliance automation software for fast-growing businesses.
overview: Vanta helps companies automate evidence collection for security and compliance programs.
bull_case: Compliance workflows are recurring, painful, and well suited to automation.
bear_case: Crowded governance tools and lower-cost competitors may pressure pricing.

intelligence.description: Vanta provides software that automates security compliance, risk management and continuous trust reporting for businesses.
company: Vanta began by helping startups automate security-compliance processes, then expanded into broader governance, risk and trust-management workflows.
Its platform connects controls, vendor data, evidence and security frameworks so companies can continuously prove compliance rather than prepare only for audits.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Vanta shows how compliance automation can become durable infrastructure as software companies sell to larger customers. Its growth provides a useful private-market benchmark for AI-enabled GRC software.

changed.text: Raised $150M in Series D financing at a $4.15B valuation.
Reported crossing $300M in annual recurring revenue and continued product expansion around AI and trust management.

takeaways: Compliance and trust are recurring workflows with clear budget owners.
Vanta's expansion beyond point-in-time audits is central to retention.
Competition across GRC and security platforms remains substantial.
